title: MZ New to RPG MMZ With A Few Questions!

posts.author: SGravity
posts.body:
Hello!
I'm new to not only this website but, to RPG Maker MZ. I'm currently playing around with it to learn what I can do with the default assets.
There are a few things I'm trying to find out, and I have two questions currently.
1) Is it possible to aggregate or combine all of the previous RPG Maker game assets that I own into RPG Maker MZ?
2) I need a bite animation for like dogs/wolves. Unless I missed it, is there a default animation for those?
Thank you in advance.

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
SGravity said:
1) Is it possible to aggregate or combine all of the previous RPG Maker game assets that I own into RPG Maker MZ?
Click to expand...
if you own previous makers, you're allowed to use their assets in others. Can't say much of anything before ACE offhand, but the formats between ACE, MV, and MZ are similar and allows you to use assets between them with some caveats.
ACE's visual assets are sized differently than MV's and MZ's, so additional work will have to be done to make them compatible. For example, ACE's tiles are 32x32, MV's is 48x48, and while MZ can support both sizes, you cant change between the two sizes without plugins. And if you did, you'd need to make sure that all assets that could possibly be seen together such as your sprites have sized counterparts for both settings.
SGravity said:
2) I need a bite animation for like dogs/wolves. Unless I missed it, is there a default animation for those?
Click to expand...
To my knowledge, no. You would have to find or make a bite animation to use. Doublecheck your DLC folder in your MZ installation to be sure there isn't one snuck in there.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: You can use the assets from any RPG Maker engine in any other engine (including non-RPG Maker engines) as long as you own the engine they came from. There may be size/formatting differences with the older engine assets but if you search the forums there will be resized/converted versions to the new engine asset standards

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
SGravity said:
2) I need a bite animation for like dogs/wolves. Unless I missed it, is there a default animation for those?
Click to expand...
As said, not directly.
But there is a function that is less documented because it was added in an update and not originally there that would help a lot with that:
Old-style picture animations instead of the default particle animations.
To get to that option, you need to go to the database, animation tab and create or select an unused slot with a right-click, then select "MV compatible animations" in the context menu.
That should make using older animations or making your own easier.
You should also make sure to work through the build-in tutorial and the help section itself, because the fan-made video-tutorials sometimes miss parts.
